access.notes: Atomic positions can also be constructed from lattice parameters a≈3.993 Å, b≈7.810 Å, c≈7.589 Å (Table 2 of the paper) and positions in Ref. [13] (Ganorkar & Priolkar, Solid State Commun. 2010).

resources.notes: Public reference structure. The solving agent may use the Materials Project, ICSD, or other open databases.

resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (open-source DFT code)
resources.notes: Open-source DFT package used to replace the proprietary VASP. The agent may also use other equivalent DFT codes (e.g., ABINIT, GPAW) if they support spin-polarized DFT+U with PAW pseudopotentials.

resources.name: PAW pseudopotentials for Gd, Ba, Co, O

access.notes: Recommended libraries: SSSP Efficiency (PBE) or PSLibrary. The agent should select pseudopotentials appropriate for spin-polarized DFT+U, including Gd 4f in valence if required.
